name: Bulgaria: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned), protocol number, sponsor, version and date match the protocol, CTIS and the rest of the package.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor are left empty, not invented.
No drafting instruction remains (yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE] labels, template 'How to use this document' text); tracked changes and comments removed.
Language matches requirements.json language_rules (Bulgarian for K1, N1, the site list and the cover letter; Bulgarian and/or English for M1, M2, O1, P1, P2, R1, S1).
Signature only where the Bulgarian rule for that document requires it (M2 signed by the PI; N1 signed by the head of the institution; insurance as issued); no invented signature blocks.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.

BG-K1.check: Uses the European Commission recruitment and informed-consent procedure template version 2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026, including additional Member States and Article 11 completion).
Answers are in Bulgarian; version and date on the document; not signed.
Inclusion procedures are explained and the first recruitment action is clearly identified.
If advertisements are used: a general description of how responses will be handled and how unsuitable respondents will receive information or advice.

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations; each 'yes' section is completed with the Bulgarian rules in national_fields (Articles 96 and 97, Ordinance No 31 witness rule, Article 35 with national representative rules); each 'no' section says not applicable.
Recruitment routes match the recruitment material (BG-K2) and the protocol.

BG-M1.check: One CV per principal investigator and site, on the EudraLex CV template, in Bulgarian and/or English.
Shows current qualifications, relevant GCP training, clinical-trial experience and patient-care experience; only trial fields were prepared by the assistant.

BG-M2.check: One declaration per principal investigator and site, on the EudraLex DoI template, in Bulgarian and/or English; interests answered by the investigator.

BG-N2.check: In Bulgarian: every planned site, the name and position of each principal investigator and the planned participant number per site; site name and address and PI name also in English.
Sites, principal investigators and participant numbers agree with CTIS, every N1 declaration, BG-O1 and K1; no signature.

BG-N1.check: The Bulgaria-specific site-suitability template from the BDA is used for every site, not the generic EU form alone.
In Bulgarian; describes why the site is suitable, including facilities, equipment, human resources and relevant expertise.
Signed by the head of the institution at the trial site.
Site name, principal investigator and planned participant number agree with BG-N2, CTIS and BG-O1.

BG-O1.check: Valid insurance covering sponsor and principal investigator liability as required by Bulgarian law, valid for the trial period and national scope.
Includes all proposed sites with the relevant departments or clinics and principal investigators.
Insured participant number is equal to or greater than the number planned for Bulgaria in CTIS.
If signed with a qualified electronic signature, submitted in a format that permits verification of the signature; Bulgarian and/or English.

BG-P1.check: On the European Commission participant-compensation template; states explicitly when no compensation is offered.
Amounts, payment links (visits, time, inconvenience, expenses), early-withdrawal rules and conditions are identical in every participant document; payment not presented as a benefit.
Trials with minors or incapacitated adults: only compensation of expenses or loss of earnings directly related to participation (template note).

BG-P2.check: A short description of trial financing and of financial transactions and compensation to participants, investigators and sites is present, as a description or in the draft sponsor-investigator and sponsor-institution contracts.
Consistent with BG-P1 and the participant documents; draft contracts without signatures; Bulgarian and/or English.

BG-R1.check: EudraLex GDPR declaration from the sponsor or its representative; no national statement added (none required in Bulgaria); date, name and role completed from sponsor data.
Consistent with the participant-facing privacy explanation and the protocol data flows.

BG-S1.check: EudraLex biological-samples declaration present when samples are collected, stored or planned for future use; new and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan.
Storage, transfer, coding, access and future use match the participant documents; optional future use is consistent with the separate participant choice.
Section 5 (national requirements) is answered without invented national rules.

BG-B1-CONTACT.check: The national cover letter is in Bulgarian and names a national contact person for the trial with telephone and email details supplied by the sponsor.
